units.source_text: 她吃了一惊，慌忙站起来，然后又端端正正地坐下，

en.t: She was startled, hurriedly stood up, and then sat down properly again,

units.source_text: 很有礼貌地双手着地施了一个礼，

en.t: very politely placed both hands on the floor and bowed,

units.source_text: 一边说“实在对不起”，一边搓揉着眼睛，跑回她们自己的房间。

en.t: and, saying “I am truly sorry” while rubbing her eyes, ran back to their own room.
